retrieval_query: 스코어가 전주를 포함하는지에 따라 달라질 경우 어떻게 해야 하나요?
answer: When scores of 《Die Forelle》 differ in whether they include an introduction, it is possible to encounter versions with or without a prelude, as the piece was composed and revised multiple times, leaving various manuscript sources. Generally, the version with an introduction is more commonly used. To determine the most appropriate version, it is advisable to compare the scores with the original manuscript.

evidence.text: 《Die Forelle》는 슈베르트가 처음 작곡한 뒤 여러 차례 개정하고 즉흥적으로 기보하는 등 여러 버전의 악보 자료를 남겼기 때문에, 악보에 따라 전주가 있거나 없을 수 있다. 두 경우 모두 가능하지만 일반적으로는 전주가 있는 악보를 많이 사용한다. 전주 유무가 다른 악보는 원본과 비교해 보는 것이 좋다.
evidence.text_en: Because Schubert left score materials in several versions after first composing Die Forelle—including multiple revisions and improvised notation—a score may include an introduction or omit it. Both options are possible, but scores with an introduction are generally used more often. It is good to compare scores that differ in whether they include an introduction with the original.
